name: labs/lando1784__pyagilis
title: Newport Agilis agUC2
intro: Newport Agilis agUC2, adapted from lando1784/pyagilis. It reads `x_steps`, `y_steps`, `x_at_limit`, `y_at_limit` and 2 more; runs `jog`, `go_to_zero`, `set_zero` and `stop_motion`. `jog`: jog axis 1 and axis 2 by signed step counts (relative motion). A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/lando1784__pyagilis --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/lando1784__pyagilis --backend fake --mcp
